synthetic local VM-backed transition validation; no Google
notes: Heap before/after is not peak heap
Temporary representation estimate is UTF-16 characters, not actual allocated memory
Storage reads include logical descriptor/block accesses from a copied snapshot; not Google RPCs
A complete chain is checked even for its latest operation; no derived index is authoritative

limitations: Authentication and source identities are simulated, not Google OAuth
Quota injection and native asynchronous ConstraintError tested, not physical quota exhaustion
Normal restart tested for P5; no power-loss proof
WebKit Playwright is not real Safari/iOS
Full snapshots and verification grow linearly; no Google latency guarantee
Persistent lock after crash without finally blocks; administrative recovery not implemented
Legacy history without an activation chain remains UNKNOWN and is not migrated
Hashes are not signatures or proof against an administrator rewriting the entire authority
No P1-P4 or operational files were modified; no routes or writers activated
